verdict.rationale: This Agent Skills package is a single logo-design skill. Its tooling covers SVG audits, test sheets, presentation boards and favicon export. The only packaging-related item is a script (tools/package_skill.py) that packages this logo skill itself for upload. That is an adjacent feature, not a meta-skill guiding an agent through writing, improving and packaging new skills, and nothing in the evidence shows such a skill-authoring tool.
